title: CONTAC Ingenieros
description:
contac.cl zoominfo.com/c/contac-ingenieros-division-sistemas/372522727 Contac is a technology company based in Santiago, Chile, specializing in operations and asset management technologies. 
They provide comprehensive automation services and real-time information systems to help industrial clients maximize their operational performance. 
The company focuses on delivering custom solutions to optimize asset management, reduce costs, and improve overall system reliability.
